displayName: RPG Runner - account deletion stalled or excessive attempts

documentation.content: The repair scan found incomplete account deletion work at least twelve hours old. Repair runs once per minute with round-robin batches of up to 32 checkpointed steps per selected request and a shared 40-second invocation budget. Attempt counts include successful steps and are diagnostics, not failure counts or elapsed minutes. Inspect oldest stage, retryable backlog, page saturation and processedStepCount; do not bypass deletion stages.
